scope: Design/source-boundary review of all 80 requirements and 27 processes; no app tests or normative validation

findings.title: Округление целочисленной ёмкости хранилища
findings.originalIssue: Формула выдаёт рациональные bytes без правила технического округления; округление каждого потока завышает общий pool, округление вниз занижает требование.
findings.resolution: Сначала суммировать точные rational bytes всех уникальных recording assignments в одном storage pool/horizon, затем применить reserve один раз и ceil до целого usable byte. Raw basis=ceil(rounded usable/redundancy fraction). UI rounding не меняет ни один verdict.
findings.acceptanceOracle: Two assignments of1bit/s for1s -> exact .25B total ->1 required usable B, not2 or0. Noninteger raw requirement rounds upward once per pool.

originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-03: For each unique recording assignment integrate bitrateBitsPerSecond * uniqueRecordedSeconds / 8; sum and apply declared reserve once. Daily recurrence is expanded with pinned timezone/rules, then overlaps are unioned; do not multiply total horizon seconds by retentionDays again. Raw estimate=usableRequired/redundancyUsableFraction only if explicit model applies; no product selection.

findings.title: Оценка VBR storage не равна гарантии retention
findings.originalIssue: Expected bitrate sizing может пройти selected capacity check, но не гарантирует срок хранения при VBR; scope гарантии не был отдельным входом/выходом.
findings.resolution: Явный sizingBasis EXPECTED_ESTIMATE либо GUARANTEED_UPPER_BOUND. Для guarantee интегрировать подтверждённый upper-bound bitrate/schedule model; missing bound ->UNRESOLVED. Estimate может пройти только estimate-capacity и всегда retentionGuarantee=NOT_ASSESSED. Recording identity=(streamId,poolId,copyRole); duplicate identity rejected; two deliberate pools/copies counted explicitly.
findings.acceptanceOracle: 1Mbps expected for3600s=450MB,4Mbps upper=1.8GB;500MB pool passes estimate but fails guaranteed upper-bound sizing. No guarantee from a generic1.1 reserve.

originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-03: For each unique recording assignment integrate bitrateBitsPerSecond * uniqueRecordedSeconds / 8; sum and apply declared reserve once. Daily recurrence is expanded with pinned timezone/rules, then overlaps are unioned; do not multiply total horizon seconds by retentionDays again. Raw estimate=usableRequired/redundancyUsableFraction only if explicit model applies; no product selection.
originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-05: Check distinct recorded channel count, peak ingress, declared stream compatibility and required usable storage independently. Selected usable capacity is not raw disk sum. Capacity failure is a completed FAIL, not an execution error.

findings.title: Запас оптического бюджета не является физическим затуханием
findings.originalIssue: Не разделены physical loss minimum и design reserve. Вычитание запаса из RxMax может скрыть перегрузку приёмника.
findings.resolution: Physical loss interval excludes reserve. Sensitivity check: TxMin-lossMax >= sensitivity+requiredSensitivityMargin. Overload: TxMax-lossMin <= receiverMax; no reserve is added to lossMin. Both directions pin separate optics/wavelength/path facts.
findings.acceptanceOracle: TxMax=-1dBm,physicalLossMin=0,receiverMax=-3,reserve2dB ->overload FAIL (-1>-3), never PASS from artificial Rx=-3.

originalContractExcerpts.LAN-05: For each optical direction compute loss interval=sum(alpha_dB_per_km*length_m/1000 + matedPairLoss + spliceLoss + declared loss terms). RxMin=TxMin-lossMax must meet sensitivity; RxMax=TxMax-lossMin must not exceed overload. Signed dBm is allowed; dB losses nonnegative. Evaluate both directions with their exact optics.

findings.title: Подсчёт адресов должен проверять полные множества ресурсов
findings.originalIssue: Count/addressConsumption не задаёт однозначно все занятые адреса многоканального модуля и может не обнаружить пересечение диапазонов.
findings.resolution: Assignments store explicit address set or versioned deterministic expansion with loop/panel address domain; expanded cardinality must equal profile consumption. Uniqueness is checked on full(domain,address) set including reserved resources, not just start address. Noncontiguous sets allowed only by selected profile.
findings.acceptanceOracle: ModuleA=[1,2],moduleB=[2,3],capacity5 ->counts4 fit, but overlap address2 gives FAIL; not silently union3 addresses.

originalContractExcerpts.FA-01: Count physical devices and consumed addresses separately, including modules occupying multiple addresses. Enforce declared uniqueness and scoped address domain. Compare independent device/address/panel limits.
originalContractExcerpts.FA-07: Validate the selected directed/loop topology, required return closure, illegal branches and declared isolator placement policy on the signal layer. Isolator behavior/short-circuit survivability needs an explicit supported model; mere component presence is not proof.

findings.title: Ключ подсчёта NVR/VMS channels/licences
findings.originalIssue: Количество encoded streams не всегда соответствует определённому профилем количеству recorder channels/licenses; ключ группировки не был обязательным.
findings.resolution: Recorder profile explicitly selects accounting basis DEVICE, ENCODED_STREAM or LICENSE_CHANNEL with exact assignments. Enforce each declared channel/license capacity separately. Sum actual ingress and recordings independently of channel grouping. Missing accounting basis ->BLOCKED.
findings.acceptanceOracle: One camera/main4Mbps+sub1Mbps,DEVICE basis,limit1 ->1 channel PASS,ingress5Mbps. ENCODED_STREAM basis/limit1 ->2 channels FAIL. Storage still counts selected distinct recordings.

originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-05: Check distinct recorded channel count, peak ingress, declared stream compatibility and required usable storage independently. Selected usable capacity is not raw disk sum. Capacity failure is a completed FAIL, not an execution error.

findings.title: Машинные зависимости нельзя выводить из поясняющих строк
findings.originalIssue: Registry dependencies смешивали notes и коды вроде ELV-PWR-01/03; машинный DAG и scope binding нельзя проверить однозначно.
findings.resolution: Keep notes separately; add typed upstreamProcesses(processCode,scopeBinding,subjectBinding,when), plus registered factKinds. Only registered code-owned bindings/conditions accepted; no free-text parsing or executable expressions. Validate known codes and DAG; external ELV3/ELV4 codes use explicit adapter contracts.
findings.acceptanceOracle: FA-06 has separate ELV-PWR-01 and03 edges. Unknown code, unresolved scope binder and cycle are rejected before registry publication.

originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-06: Check medium/interface/category and installed link composition against explicit policy limits. If powered, reference matching scoped PWR-06 result; preserve per-segment power applicability. Never use room distance or duplicate cable allocations.
originalContractExcerpts.FA-06: Check distinct active devices, output current limit, peak applicability and terminal voltage using shared PWR evidence. Respect declared simultaneous notification policy; do not infer sound pressure/acoustic coverage.

findings.title: Gross versus already-usable rack capacity basis
findings.originalIssue: Available RU не указывает, были ли резервы/неиспользуемые зоны уже исключены; повторное вычитание даёт неправильный margin.
findings.resolution: Capacity basis is GROSS_WITH_EXCLUSIONS or NET_USABLE. Gross subtracts explicit unavailable/reserved set once; net never subtracts those again and records their provenance. Equipment demand is distinct from excluded reserve. Actual slot/depth/thermal fit stays NOT_ASSESSED until ELV6.
findings.acceptanceOracle: Gross6RU,reserved1RU,equipment3RU ->free2RU. Net usable5RU with same reservation already excluded ->free2RU, not1RU.

originalContractExcerpts.LAN-06: Sum demand from distinct equipment; report RU/weight/depth requirements and comparison only for explicit available limits. No slot placement, clearance, thermal-layout or cabinet-fit certification; those belong to ELV6.

findings.title: Полнота угловых размерностей CCTV coverage
findings.originalIssue: Первичный контракт разрешал квалифицировать footprint при недоступных FOV angles, хотя полный camera coverage process обещает углы обзора.
findings.resolution: Горизонтальный/вертикальный FOV interval обязательны; bounded rational backend, range reduction, alternating series/pi identity и iteration/width limits закреплены. Footprint-only не даёт полного PASS.
findings.acceptanceOracle: Sensor6x4mm,focal6mm,height3m ->footprint3x2m; horizontal FOV(.9272952180,.9272952181)rad,vertical(.6435011087,.6435011089)rad. Missing/convergence failure blocks full qualification.

originalContractExcerpts.CCTV-01: Cast sensor corner rays through captured calibrated pinhole frame; intersect t=(planeOffset-dot(normal,origin))/dot(normal,direction), require positive finite intersection and supported model. Clip ordered footprint to zone. FOV=2*atan(sensorDimension/(2*focalLength)) uses separately versioned bounded backend; exact rational footprint may qualify independently of an unavailable angle display. Parallel/horizon/uncertain intersections remain unresolved. No DORI or occlusion success inferred.
